note: A longer skipping tune learned in named stages (with the tune, the tune muted over the chords, then a cappella) at 40 bpm, then a tune of the singer's own from the low Do, Mi and Sol over a drone, with the one care line. The old Key choice is moves (key any, tempo 40 to 60), and the line about another key opens with {{?key}}.

exercise.title: A longer skipping tune, then your own
exercise.why: A skip lands on Do, Mi or Sol, the notes of the home chord, so a longer tune is the same few skips in a new order, and your own tune can be built from them too.

cells.text:
Press Play below to hear the tune at {{=bpm}}: the mic starts with it. Listen once, then press Play again and sing along. Sing it on "oo".
Sing along with the tune a few times. Then press Tune below to mute the tune, and sing it over the chords alone.
Once the last bar comes out as sure as the first, press Chords to mute the chords too, and sing the tune a cappella.
{{?key}}In another key the notes change, and the tune still skips by the same distances.

Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together. Make up a tune of skips between {{1}}, {{3}} and {{5}}, and end it on {{1}}. Sing it on "la".
Practice until your tune comes back the same way twice in a row.
_Don't reach for high notes: the low {{1}}, {{3}} and {{5}} are enough for a tune._
